title: Rockfall hazard on a coastal site: consent route and title notice (Motueka)
jurisdiction: New Zealand (MBIE, Building Act 2004): comparative test only; not an Alberta case; no Alberta applicability asserted
code_edition: Building Act natural-hazard provisions ss71–74 with NZ Building Code references
document_type: MBIE determination under Building Act 2004 s188 (regulator decision on an individual matter); not an applicant's alternative-solution file

facts.text: Authority proposed to grant a building consent under s72 subject to a s73 notice on the title because of a rockfall natural hazard; mitigation relies on passive protection structures.
The determination cites the Ministry's rockfall design guidance (2016) for passive protection structures.
Conclusion: s71(2)(a) is satisfied because adequate provision has been made to protect land and buildings from the rockfall hazard.
